description:
Custom ChudPresence media metadata patches for:

- Hulu 6.34.0+18552420-google: Expose Hulu media metadata.
- YouTube Music 8.40.54: Enrich media metadata.
- YouTube 20.40.45: Expose YouTube media metadata.

Add the patches.json URL from the repository README as a custom source in ReVanced Manager. Keep the official patch source for upstream features.

Assets contain only the custom patch bundle and its SHA-256 checksum. Obtain compatible stock APKs separately. The upstream YouTube quality backport is provided as source in upstream-fixes/ and is not included in this custom bundle.
